# YTSaveX - High-Performance Online YouTube Downloader
> YTSaveX is a free, web-based utility for downloading YouTube videos, audio tracks, and playlists.

## Supported Formats
- Video: MP4 (1080p Full HD, 720p HD, 480p, 360p)
- Audio: High-fidelity MP3 (320 kbps)
- Features: Full playlist extraction, instant stream conversion, zero invasive ads.

## Available Languages
- English: https://ytsavex.com/en
- French: https://ytsavex.com/fr
- Spanish: https://ytsavex.com/es
- Arabic: https://ytsavex.com/ar
